title: NBN POI 4APL (Aspley), 4IPS (Ipswich), 4WOB (Woolloongabba), 4CAB (Caboolture), 4ROT (Rockhampton), 4BBE (Bundaberg), 4KLG (Petrie), 4TOB (Toowoomba), 4BNB (Aspley Depot) - Splice Enclosure Repair
current_summary: An upstream provider will be repairing a fibre splice enclosure that supports backhaul to several QLD nbn POIs (Aspley, Ipswich, Woolloongabba, Caboolture, Rockhampton, Bundaberg, Petrie, Toowoomba, Aspley Depot). This work is scheduled from 11:00 PM AEST on 18 August to 7:00 AM AEST on 19 August. nbn services at these POIs may experience interruptions for up to 8 hours within this window. We will monitor progress and work to minimise impact. Services are expected to be restored by 7:00 AM AEST.

title: NBN POI 3HAW (Hawthorn) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Planned maintenance will move nbn services connected to the Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne to a new router at Exhibition Exchange. Work is scheduled from 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 8 September. Customers with nbn services on this POI may experience interruptions during the window, for up to 2 hours. Our team will complete the change and monitor services to restore connectivity as soon as the work is finished.

title: National - Maintain the Network
current_summary: Urgent planned maintenance by an upstream access network provider is scheduled nationwide on Friday 14 August 2026 from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST. Some services may lose connectivity during the window, with a single interruption of up to 3 hours per service expected. Our team will monitor closely and work with network partners to minimise impact. No separate restoration time has been provided beyond the maintenance window.
